linux_test.passed: 6 lib, 18 http_query, 1 proxy_env, 9 redaction_retry, 2 tls_query, 0 doctests

probe_attempt_1.cause: harness: HeaderMap debug contains the letter a; gateway() was passed Ctx

probe_attempt_2.cause: harness required the hint retry later to survive token a; the SDK removed that letter

findings.evidence: probe/out/probe-report.json token_len_1, token_len_6, token_len_7, token_len_8, marker_a, marker_e, marker_star
findings.actual: Accepted lengths 1, 6, 7, and 8 are stripped from message and hint. Wire Authorization and body matched the handwritten bytes. Display, Debug, and Client Debug omit tokens of length 8. One-byte a and e also occur inside static English in Display and Client Debug; message() for those cases is the omission marker and message_has_token is false.

findings.evidence: probe/out/probe-report.json sql_len_1 through sql_overlap; unit duplicate-needle test
findings.actual: SQL lengths 1, 4, 8, and 14, quoted SQL, unicode, a newline, a token prefix, and an overlapping token are absent from message(). NUL SQL is rejected before a socket. Duplicate needles are omitted by the direct scrub test.

findings.evidence: probe/out/probe-report.json percent_partial, percent_all_bytes, percent_mixed_case, slash_escaped, plus_for_space, json_unicode_escape_decoded, nested_percent, json_literal_backslash_u
findings.actual: One %HH pass, either hex case, a JSON-decoded escape, \/ for slash, and + for a space byte are removed. Doubled %25 stays a percent sign (nested_left true, message_len 12). A literal backslash-u sequence stays (literal_u_left true, message_len 6). The space spelling of a plus-SQL stays (message_len 3) while the raw plus-SQL is absent.

100000000 seconds is Decimal and is not retried (hits 1, retry_after_ms 100000000000). Equal-to-max 2s is not retried (retry_after_ms 2000). Leading zero 000000001 retries once (hits 2, elapsed_ms 1028). Leading zero 000000003 does not (retry_after_ms 3000). u64::MAX does not sleep (retry_after_ms 18446744073709551615000). Overflow and a 30-digit leading-zero overflow do not retry. All-zero 9, 128, and 4096 retry with delay 0 (hits 4). 4097 zeros are Overflow (hits 1, retry_after null). Missing, duplicate, 1.5, and an HTTP-date use backoff (hits 4, elapsed_ms 1445 to 1463). Max extra attempts stay at 4 hits. Overall 1200ms with Retry-After 1 stops at hits 2, elapsed_ms 1023, retry_after_ms 1000.

Origin, authority, path, and mount are absent from message() and from Client Debug. Scheme case HTTP:// is removed (message_len 20). Display and Debug of the gateway error keep query_id q_abc123 and omit the locator.

HeaderValue::set_sensitive(true) is set. Header debug is the word Sensitive. HeaderMap debug is identical for token !, a long token, and token a, and it contains Sensitive. BearerToken Display and Debug are BearerToken([redacted]).

observations.actual: obs_loopback_127_255: kind transport, endpoint_rejected false, reached_client true, elapsed_ms 48. The address is inside 127.0.0.0/8. The socket result stays an observation.
plus_secret_space_reflection message_len 3, message_has_sql false. + in the secret matches a space in the text. A space in the text is left in place when the secret contains +.

nested_percent message_len 12, nested_left true. json_literal_backslash_u message_len 6, literal_u_left true. json_unicode_escape_decoded message_is_marker true, message_len 10. One percent pass. JSON decoding happens before scrub.
zeros_4097 hits 1, retry_after_ms null, elapsed_ms 4. A digit string longer than 4096 is Overflow. The bytes past 4096 are not scanned. The client does not fall through to the 200ms backoff.

marker_a display_has_token true, debug_has_token true, client_debug_has_token true, message_has_token false, message_len 9, hint_len 9. marker_e has the same Display and Client Debug flags, message_len 4, hint_len 9. The letter a occurs in status, PARSE, and redacted. The letter e occurs in gateway and redacted. message() is the omission marker.
